title: Compute LDOS spatial decay
action: Evaluate the impurity-modified local density of states ρ(R, ω = -0.7Δ) using the analytic formula (impurity coupling Un_z = 1.0, energy unit Δ = 1, length unit a = 1) for at least 20 R values from 0.1a to 10a, and write the results to ldos_decay.csv.
description: LDOS values at a fixed energy for a range of distances, used to verify spatial decay behavior.
output_schema: Columns: R (distance in units of a), rho (LDOS dimensionless at ω = -0.7Δ). At least 20 rows.

title: Compute energy-resolved spin density parity
action: Evaluate the spin density components s_x, s_y, s_z at R = 0.5a for ω from -Δ to Δ (at least 200 equally spaced points) using the analytic formula with the same parameters (Un_z=1.0, Δ=1, a=1), and write the results to spin_parity.csv.
description: Energy-resolved spin density values to verify parity properties and sum rule.
output_schema: Columns: omega (in units of Δ), s_x, s_y, s_z (dimensionless). At least 200 rows.

title: Compute RKKY susceptibility spatial decay
action: Compute the RKKY spin susceptibility χ_zz(R) using the analytic expression (with a=1, ℏv_s = 1) for at least 20 R values from 0.1a to 10a, and write the results to rkky_decay.csv.
description: RKKY susceptibility values to verify spatial decay behavior and sign.
output_schema: Columns: R (in units of a), chi_zz (dimensionless). At least 20 rows.

title: Compute impurity-induced bound state resonance energy
action: Determine the resonance energy ω_loc by solving the pole condition of the scattering amplitude, using a short-distance cutoff a0 = 0.01a and Un_z = 1.0, and write the positive value (in units of Δ) to resonance_energy.txt.
description: The resonance energy of the impurity-induced bound state for comparison with the analytic prediction.
output_schema: Single floating-point number: ω_loc in units of Δ.
